facts.fact: The Public Prosecution says its criminal-judgment enquiry service is provided through the enquirer's digital identity system, with the Ministry of Communications and IT, to verify the identity of the person asking.

systems.owner: Ministry of Communications and Information Technology

EGY.note: Civil register and ID are not mentioned.
No enrolment count or share is stated.
No number at birth is mentioned.
Who operates the ID system is not stated.

facts.fact: The Public Prosecution says criminal judgments are recorded against citizens' national number in its digital systems.
The Public Prosecution says its online service verifies the enquirer through the digital identity system, on records keyed to the national number.
